title: Stop the marketing hero effects from breaking hydration on about 25 pages

source.ref: Visual sweep 2026-11-02: a real browser logs 'Hydration failed' on /pricing, /themes, /themes/*, /for, /help, /features, /stories, /discover, /discover/*, /spaces, /spaces/directory, /networks, /circles, /the-community and /system

detail:
SiteFx decorated the page on mount (a .tx-field with halos and jewels inside every hero and section, a transform on the hero photo). A page behind a loading.tsx or Suspense boundary hydrates after the layout island commits, so React met server HTML with extra nodes, threw away the server render of that page and rebuilt it on the client. Cost: wasted work, a possible flash of the hero, and no streaming benefit on every marketing page. Fix: SiteFx waits until the nodes it decorates carry a React fiber (hydrated), with a 2.5 second limit so the effect is late at worst and never missing.

 Fixed 2026-11-02: SiteFx waits for hydrated nodes (2.5 s limit). Verified in a browser: no hydration error on /pricing, /for, /help, /discover, /circles, /themes/nocturne; 9 .tx-field still decorate /pricing.
